app.title: Teal – A statically-typed dialect of Lua
app.author: Lyngbakr
app.description: A statically-typed dialect of Lua with a small runtime and optional type checker.
proposed_tests: Clone the Teal repository and run the build script to install the interpreter.
Execute the provided `hello_world.t` example and assert the output is 'Hello, world!'.
Compile a small Teal program to Lua and compare byte‑code size with a vanilla Lua equivalent.
Measure the execution time of a computationally intensive loop in both Teal and Lua and compare performance.
Run the built‑in type checker on a file with intentional type errors and confirm it reports the expected diagnostics.
